scope: Fictional demonstration and human grading only; not independent ChatGPT response evidence.
warning: Never treat trace-gate or reference-case checks as model behavior or legal semantic verification.

cases.first_turn: My EU spouse says we will go to a different Member State and the visa officer insists on tourist financial evidence. Which rules apply?
cases.later_user_reply: Correction: our actual destination is my spouse's home Member State, and we lived in a different EU state together before.
must_revise: preserve usable guidance on evidence and route
must_not: declare no EU rights solely from home-state destination
repeat unchanged first answer as if correction did not occur

cases.first_turn: My local resident card has expired; an EU-family visa consulate says it cannot accept my application.
cases.later_user_reply: There is an official grace period; my presence is lawful during renewal.
must_initial: distinguish residence document expiry from lawful presence
ask what status applies at the date of lodging
must_revise: reassess territorial competence based on new answer
must_not: assert lawfulness confirmed solely by user statement

cases.first_turn: The visa portal says validated, and the officer at the desk refused to hand me anything.
cases.later_user_reply: I have a signed refusal decision bearing a service date.
must_initial: distinguish online validation from formal lodging
must_revise: check actual service date and national competent appeal route
not assume informal complaint pauses clock
must_not: keep treating case exclusively as not-lodged

cases.first_turn: I am travelling with my EU partner to another Member State; do we get the simplified visa documents?
cases.later_user_reply: We are unmarried durable partners, not spouses or registered partners.
must_revise: consider Article 3(2) facilitation and distinct proof/assessment
must_not: treat all partners as Article 2(2)(a) spouses
say no rights exist solely because unmarried

cases.first_turn: The consulate demanded a local residence document from the spouse of an EU citizen applying for a family visa.
cases.later_user_reply: They said it was solely to decide whether their post may accept the application.
must_revise: address consular territorial competence and proportionality individually
do not convert competence proof into ordinary supporting documents
must_not: conflate purpose with tourist visa list

cases.first_turn: I never received a written refusal; the mission has not issued any decision.
cases.later_user_reply: I found a document marked refusal, but I do not know when it was served.
must_initial: ask actual procedural status and relevant dates
must_revise: identify and correct earlier assumption without accusing user of deceit
seek service facts before deadline estimate
give preservation and formal-remedy information with limitations
